newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Analysts see same Danish Dec unemployment.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Analysts see same Danish Dec unemployment.

text.p: Nine bank economists polled by Reuters in a survey issued on Wednesday forecast average unchanged, year-on-year, seasonally-adjusted Danish unemployment for December 1996 of 8.2 percent of the workforce.
The estimates ranged between 8.1 and 8.2 percent. November's unemployment rate was 8.2 percent against 8.3 percent on an annual basis in October.
The Danish National Statistics Office issues December unemployment data on Thursday January 23 at 0830 gmt.
